title: Bounds for squares and cubes
statement: Let $n,i$ be natural numbers, and let $L$ be an integer word bound. If $8n+1\le L$ and $i$ is at most the least natural number $r$ such that $n\le r^3$, then $|(i: \mathbb Z)i|\le L$ and $|(i: \mathbb Z)i^2|\le L$.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is at most the least natural number $r$ with $n\le r^3$
